facts.fact: The ICT minister Adji Ali Salatou opened the "atelier national de validation" of the PNDN 2026-2035 and its Plan d'Action Sectoriel 2026-2030 in Niamey on 11 March 2026, saying the workshop would examine the proposed orientations and enrich the planned actions; no adopting act or body is named.
facts.system: Politique nationale de développement du numérique 2026-2035

facts.fact: The article states the PNDN is accompanied by a Plan d'Action Sectoriel 2026-2030 whose "actions prévues" the workshop was to enrich; it gives no cost.
facts.system: Politique nationale de développement du numérique 2026-2035

facts.fact: The national validation workshop for the PNDN 2026-2035 and its 2026-2030 action plan opened on 11 March 2026.

systems.tiers: Three axes: governance and security of the digital sector; digital infrastructure and services; digital skills and innovation. Aims include fibre interconnection hub, e-government, rural connectivity, financial inclusion and local content and start-ups; implementation to rest on an institutional mechanism for coordination, steering and monitoring-evaluation (no body named).

note: Class national rests on the stated scope (economic and social transformation plus e-government, across three axes). The article is the opening of the validation workshop, not an adoption.
